=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:699-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The expired-note park branch in unblock_triage_superseded_note adds `ai:needs-human` and a digest entry, then returns 0. It never posts a trusted `<!-- ai:unblock:v1 ... verdict=close ... -->` or `<!-- ai:unblock-wait:v1 ... -->` marker, so scripts/unblock_scan.py never treats the item as parked (lines 376-380 need `_latest_verdict(...) == "close"`) and never throttles it (lines 386-389, `MARKER_PREFIXES` at line 101).
  WHY: The item keeps `ai:blocked`. After the inflight window passes, every poller tick can redispatch it. Each run repeats the judge run, the check_triage_resolution.py gate and the park, and takes the tick's single dispatch slot. This turns the bounded wait-lifetime hold into unbounded hourly redispatch, against unblock_scan.py:372-373 ("never re-judge it on every tick"). The existing `needs_human` op at ~1335-1360 avoids this because the judge posts its close marker before parking. Four reviewers rated this MAJOR; google_gemini stated no severity.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:~699-716 (unblock_triage_superseded_note `else` path after the park call: `outcome=held reason=park_failed`) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: With `NEEDS_HUMAN_DIGEST_ENABLED=false`, `needs_human_park` returns `outcome=skip` (operator_step_issue.py lines 662-664). The jq parked/updated check fails, so the branch holds and returns 0 on every later run with no end.
  WHY: The kill switch is meant to let parked items reach the judge again and restore the legacy close (unblock_scan.py:374-375). On this path the item is never closed, resumed or parked, and is redispatched hourly forever. The behaviour is documented, so it is deliberate, but it contradicts the kill switch's contract.
- changelog.d/9659-gitleaksignore-conflict-union.md:10 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The row `| Extra GitHub API calls | at most 1 comment per check-triage issue |` was not updated after the last run added the expired-note park. The park adds a label POST (operator_step_issue.py:671) and digest list/create/PATCH calls (operator_step_issue.py:685-736), and these repeat on re-park.
  WHY: The released changelog will state an API budget that the shipped code exceeds, while README.md and the agents fragment were updated. This is a documentation inaccuracy only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If it returns resolved or already_resolved, the gate closes the issue as it already does; otherwise, post one trusted note." The item also "is not resumed with /answer or /approved."
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_triage_superseded_note()
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: For a returned gate status other than unverified, lines 690-692 log gate_terminal and return 1. The caller then continues normal judging, which can resume the issue instead of posting the required note. The gate can return not_triage.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_triage_superseded_note, expired-note park branch (lines ~699-716: `local -a triage_park_args=(needs-human park ...)`, then `unblock_log ... op=triage_superseded outcome=parked reason=note_expired` and `return 0`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The park branch never posts an `ai:unblock:v1 ... verdict=close` or `ai:unblock-wait:v1` marker, so the scan's parked skip (unblock_scan.py lines 376-380), `_terminal_unchanged` (lines 234-263) and the recent_verdict throttle (lines 386-389) never fire. `ai:unblock-triage-superseded:v1` is not in `MARKER_PREFIXES` (line 101).
  WHY: The item is redispatched every hour, with no end, until a person acts, and it can starve other blocked items of the one-per-tick slot. This goes against unblock_scan.py:372-373 and CLAUDE.md §14/§26. Suggested fix: post an `ai:unblock-wait:v1` marker after a successful park, or a `close`-verdict marker before it.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_triage_superseded_note, `else` path after the park call (`outcome=held reason=park_failed`), with operator_step_issue.py lines 662-664 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the digest is disabled, `needs_human_park` returns `outcome=skip`, so the branch holds and returns 0 indefinitely.
  WHY: This contradicts the kill switch's contract (unblock_scan.py:374-375). The item gets hourly judge runs forever with no final outcome.
- changelog.d/9659-gitleaksignore-conflict-union.md:line 10, `| Extra GitHub API calls | at most 1 comment per check-triage issue |` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The API budget row was not updated for the park's label POST (operator_step_issue.py:671) and digest calls (operator_step_issue.py:685-736).
  WHY: The released changelog will state an API budget that the shipped code exceeds. This is a documentation issue only.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_triage_superseded_note, `--reason "triage_superseded: the check stayed unverified past the wait lifetime"`
  PROBLEM: `needs_human_park` logs the reason's first token (operator_step_issue.py:661), so the logged token is `triage_superseded:` with a trailing colon.
  WHY: Log parsers that key on the reason token will not match. Fix: drop the colon or use a dash (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTE: Reported no task gaps. Did not adopt the pass-1 gate_terminal TASK_GAP (`not_triage`/`disabled`), calling it deliberate and safe. Did not adopt the pass-1 findings based only on pre-push gate test names, because the PR head check-runs show `failed_count: 0`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:709 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The triage-superseded note expiry branch parks the item using operator_step_issue.py but does not add the required `close` or `wait` verdict marker (`<!-- ai:unblock:v1 ... verdict=close ... -->` or `<!-- ai:unblock-wait:v1 ... -->`).
  WHY: The unblock_scan.py state machine does not recognise the item as parked, so the poller reruns the triage gate and the park logic every tick instead of throttling, and uses dispatch slots unnecessarily.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:lines 699-716 (the `unblock_hours_since` >= `unblock_wait_max_hours` branch that calls `operator_step_issue.py needs-human park`, logs `op=triage_superseded outcome=parked reason=note_expired`, and returns 0) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The park posts no `ai:unblock:v1 ... verdict=close` or `ai:unblock-wait:v1` marker. The scan's parked skip (around line 376) needs `ai:needs-human`, `_latest_verdict(...) == "close"` and digest membership.
  WHY: Every 60 minutes the poller redispatches the item and reruns the judge, the gate and the park, holding the tick's dispatch slot. The bounded hold becomes permanent hourly redispatch. The existing `needs_human` op at lines 1335-1360 avoids this because the close marker comes first.
- changelog.d/9659-gitleaksignore-conflict-union.md:row `| Extra GitHub API calls | at most 1 comment per check-triage issue |` (around line 10) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The API budget row understates the cost: each park does a label POST plus digest list/create/PATCH calls. README.md and the agents fragment were updated, but this row was not.
  WHY: Operators auditing GitHub API usage from the changelog will get a distorted cost projection.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_triage_superseded_note(), lines 704-713 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The expired-note branch parks the issue in the needs-human digest and returns without posting a trusted unblock verdict marker. The scanner treats an item as parked only with the ai:needs-human label, digest membership and a newest trusted verdict of close.
  WHY: Once the inflight window expires, scripts/unblock_scan.py dispatches the item again. Each run retries the park and uses a dispatch slot.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: “If it returns resolved or already_resolved, the gate closes the issue as it already does; otherwise, post one trusted note.” The item also “is not resumed with /answer or /approved.”
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_triage_superseded_note()
  Evidence of absence: For a returned gate status other than unverified, lines 690-692 log gate_terminal and return 1. The caller then continues normal judging, which can resume the issue instead of posting the required note. The gate can return not_triage.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_triage_superseded_note, expired-note park branch, lines 700-716 (park call at 704-708, return 0 at 713); note marker at line 694 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The park returns 0 without a trusted verdict marker. The note marker `<!-- ai:unblock-triage-superseded:v1 item=<n> -->` matches neither `MARKER_PREFIXES` (scripts/unblock_scan.py:101) nor `VERDICT_PREFIX` (scripts/unblock_scan.py:104). The parked skip (scripts/unblock_scan.py:376-379) and the marker throttle (scripts/unblock_scan.py:386-388) therefore both fail.
  WHY: The item is picked again on every scan outside the cooldown/inflight window. Each pick is a full judge run, a gate rerun and a re-park (`outcome=updated`), in an unbounded loop that uses the judge dispatch slot, against scripts/unblock_scan.py:372-373. The existing op avoids this through its close marker (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1319-1361). Fix: add an `ai:unblock:v1 ... verdict=close` or `ai:unblock-wait:v1` marker when the park succeeds.
- changelog.d/9659-gitleaksignore-conflict-union.md:line 10, table row `| Extra GitHub API calls | at most 1 comment per check-triage issue |` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The park (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:704-716) adds a label POST (scripts/operator_step_issue.py:671) and digest list/create/PATCH calls (scripts/operator_step_issue.py:685-736). README.md:128 and agents.d/9659-gitleaksignore-conflict-union.md were updated, but this row was not.
  WHY: An operator auditing GitHub API usage will see more calls than the changelog documents.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:line 705, `--reason "triage_superseded: the check stayed unverified past the wait lifetime"`
  PROBLEM: scripts/operator_step_issue.py:661 (`reason_text.split(" ", 1)[0]`) logs `reason=triage_superseded:` with a trailing colon.
  WHY: The token does not match the other reason tokens in the log registry. Fix: drop the colon or start the reason with a bare token (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTE: Reported no task gaps. Did not re-emit the gate_terminal TASK_GAP: `not_triage` (scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:1034) and `disabled` were adjudicated in an earlier run, and normal judging is the correct fallback for them. Also did not re-emit the pre-push gate failures in tests/test_changelog_fragment_contract.py:67-75, test_gh_api_write_guard.py and test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, calling them sandbox noise not caused by the diff (CI `failed_count: 0`).
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
